literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe the same experiment: N-terminal split-YFP (BiFC) fusions to full-length GIRK3 (KCNJ9), shown to be functional (L2). However, the authoritative topology places the N-terminus (residues 1–58) entirely intracellular. An N-terminal tag on this protein therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space, and cannot serve as a surface epitope tag. The sole extracellular region is the P-loop/turret (residues 83–134), but no ledger line reports any insertion there. The C-terminus (157–393) is also intracellular. With no ledger evidence for any extracellular-facing insertion, zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: N-terminal split-YFP (NYFP/CYFP) fusion to full-length GIRK3 is tolerated and functional (L2), but the N-terminus (residues 1–58) is intracellular per topology; this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
